Productivity rules. Rules decide which applications and websites count as productive, neutral or unproductive. Without rules, time stays unclassified.
Open Productivity, and choose the Rules and work profiles tab.
For a quick start, click Starter rules, to add common rules in one go.
Then open Not classified yet. It lists what people actually used in the last thirty days. Click Classify, and choose Productive, Neutral or Unproductive.
To add a rule yourself, click Add rule. Choose Application or Website, and enter the program or the domain. A domain includes its subdomains.
Pick the category, and the scope: the whole company, a department, a team, a role, or a work profile. Then click Add rule.
The most specific rule wins: work profile, then team, department, role, and finally the whole company. So the Visa department can treat a site as productive, while it stays neutral for everyone else.
Use Bulk add to paste many applications or websites at once. For example, a list of social media sites, as unproductive.
Every rule change recalculates the figures. The productive share is productive time, divided by productive, neutral and unproductive time together. Unclassified time is left out.
Done. Next, see each person's productivity and activity details.
